subject: Web Development
title: HTTP/2 and Multiplexing
description: Learn HTTP/2 and Multiplexing in one minute.

hook.text: HTTP/1.1 loaded resources one at a time per connection. Six connections was the browser limit.

buildup.text: Developers hacked around this by combining files, using sprites, and sharding domains.

discovery.text: HTTP/2 introduced multiplexing — many resources flowing through one connection simultaneously.

twist.text: Many old optimization tricks like file concatenation actually hurt performance under HTTP/2.

climax.text: HTTP/2 made the network layer smarter so developers could stop working around its limits.

punchline.text: Better protocols made old hacks unnecessary.
